page.overview:
Who is Lightning?

Lightning is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. She is a Grymoirian incarnation of Lightning originating from Final Fantasy XIII. Lightning is one of the four character representatives of the Final Fantasy XIII series, the other three being Snow, Chocolatte and Serah (the latter appearing only in the Maxima version).

The player controls Lightning in the Nebula Storm minigame.

The player can take on an Intervention Quest that centers around Lightning.

Lightning also appears in the following Intervention Quests.
